jobs.title: Predictive Data Analyst
jobs.description:
VARITE is looking for a qualified Predictive Data Analyst
for one of its clients located in Los Angeles, CA

WHAT THE CLIENT DOES?

A large county government entity providing comprehensive public services including public health, social services, public safety, infrastructure management, community development, and regional administration.

WHAT WE DO?

Established in the Year 2000, VARITE is an award-winning minority business enterprise providing global consulting & staffing services to Fortune 1000 companies and government agencies. With 850+ global consultants, VARITE is committed to delivering excellence to its customers by leveraging its global experience and expertise in providing comprehensive scientific, engineering, technical, and non-technical staff augmentation and talent acquisition services.

Job Title: Predictive Data Analyst

Duration: 12 months

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Work Mode: Onsite

Pay Rate Range: $35.00 - $40.00/hr on W2

HERE'S WHAT YOU’LL DO:
The Predictive Data Analyst will support stakeholders by defining data needs and ensuring data science and advanced analytics projects meet business objectives across various levels.
The Predictive Data Analyst will use statistical programming languages and tools for data manipulation, analysis, and visualization, including end-to-end predictive modeling from exploratory analysis to deployment and results interpretation.
The Predictive Data Analyst will manage data through querying, merging, quality control, regular reporting, special project deliverables, and documentation.
Additionally, the Predictive Data Analyst will collaborate with IT and data engineering staff to develop data pipelines, designs and maintains reports and dashboards, and will work directly with program staff to ensure analyses lead to actionable insights for decision-making and program improvement.
The Predictive Data Analyst will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on cross-agency justice-involved datasets and managed care plan reporting, owning the associated business logic, query design, and report definitions. Functioning as a technical lead within a collaborative team structure, the Predictive Data Analyst will consult on the technical feasibility of project intakes, takes a lead role on Tableau dashboard development, or similar, and API reporting, and drives rigorous quality assurance.
The Predictive Data Analyst will handle technical documentation and actively engages in team Agile/Scrum workflows by participating in daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to commit to and deliver technical tasks.

Skills Required
The Predictive Data Analyst will possess knowledge and experience in predictive analytics and tool development; ability to work directly with a client-centric relational database; have strong technical knowledge to conduct analysis and build reports from an SQL database; comfortable with various analytical tools; ability to take the lead on projects where the best path forward is unclear; excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills; and exceptional customer service.

Experience Required:
Four (4) years of experience with responsibility for planning, designing, conducting, and evaluating research projects involving the application of techniques of machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to complex experimental designs, leading to actionable findings and recommendations.

Education Required:
A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Psychology, or Public Health that includes 12 semester or 18 quarter units of coursework in data science, predictive analytics, quantitative research methods, or statistical analysis.

Description

The Department of Criminal Justice Training (DOCJT), located in Richmond, is Kentucky's state-of-the-art facility providing basic and advanced training for law enforcement officers and telecommunicators across the Commonwealth. DOCJT is seeking a Program Coordinator to support the development, legal review, and quality assurance of law enforcement training programs while providing administrative and legal support to agency leadership.

This position plays a critical role in coordinating the agency's Tier One Curriculum Review Program, which helps ensure that training materials are legally sound, current, accurate, and consistent with Kentucky law and agency standards. Working closely with agency leadership, instructors, subject matter experts, and the Office of Legal Services General Counsel, the Program Coordinator helps maintain the integrity and effectiveness of training delivered to Kentucky's public safety professionals.

In addition to curriculum coordination, this position provides support in legal research, document preparation and review, records management, policy and regulatory assistance, legal case coordination, and other administrative processes that support the agency's mission.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To The Following

Coordinates, reviews and administers all activities of the Tier One Curriculum Review Program by monitoring policies, objectives and procedures related to curriculum review. Organizes and participates in curriculum program implementation for targeted law enforcement audience. Reviews, reports, and records submitted curriculum by agency training sections.
Requests and collects training data as needed. Communicates and reports program data to staff as guidance tool on recommended curriculum changes. Writes, edits and coordinates development of materials and manuals for program. Performs in-depth analysis of Tier One Curriculum Review Program needs and recommends policy and procedural modifications.
Interprets statues, agency policies and regulations to ensure program remains compliant and legal. Promotes statutory mission, goals and objectives. Communicates procedural changes to program leadership. Attends meetings to gather and distribute program information.
Conducts legal research, drafts legal documents, pleadings, letters, and reports for attorney. Provides administrative support to attorney staff, including scheduling, updating and maintaining litigation. Maintains case documents and assists attorney with legal case file requests. Provides support to attorney for matters involving recruit discipline.
Coordinates legal case management and compiles records for hearings. Coordinates appeals, including scheduling. Correctly applies statutes, policies and regulations to ensure compliance. Maintains case files. Keeps abreast of changes in agency or department law, rules and regulations relating to the area of assignment.
Other duties as assigned.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Requires proficient experience and knowledge in: SharePoint, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Articulate, and video platforms for online and face-to-face classroom materials.
High-level editing experience for text, context, and multimedia content.
Experience communicating with stakeholders using online tools: TEAMS, Live editing tools, Microsoft 365.
Experience working with legal documents and regulations and using platforms such as LexisNexis.
Experience with research and data collection in connection with curriculum review processes, technical writing, and legal statutes.
Experience in collaboration with multilevel stakeholders, including faculty, administrators, and government agencies.
Analytical, decision-making skills in time management and project management processes.
Instructional and/or Curriculum Design background preferred.
Ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines.
Requires a high level of attention to detail with strong reading comprehension and fluency.

Additional / Supplemental Information:

Maintain a valid driver’s license.
Frequently communicate in person or by other means of technology.
Spend a major portion of time using a computer.
Travel required (state vehicle provided).

A background check is required. Final job offer is contingent upon successful completion of background investigation.
